description: Suggests oral contraceptives over injectable contraceptives for women with BMI ≥27 kg/m2 with comorbidities or BMI ≥30 kg/m2 seeking contraception, provided they are well‑informed and oral contraceptives are not contraindicated. Triggers include clinician questions such as “Which contraceptive method is less likely to cause weight gain in this obese patient?” or “Should I recommend oral pills instead of depot injection for this patient with BMI 29 and hypertension?”.
